boundary: Single-worker throughput confirmation only. It does not qualify distributed execution, scheduler requeue, long-context cost or data eligibility, and it does not authorize production training. The four-worker and scheduler phases of the runbook remain separate.
command: From the clean bundled code checkout after `scripts.gh200_check bind ..`, run `python experiments/qualification/check_throughput_packet.py experiments/qualification/throughput-gh200.json --print-commands`. Substitute selected geometry in the copied commands, preserving tokens per update; do not edit the tracked packet during measurement. Printed selected values are preflight probes, not measured selections.

common.data_dir_note: Relative to the bundled code/ checkout after binding. Only end-to-end mode reads the transported pilot-data/ pack; compute mode is synthetic.

decisions_to_record: device_batch_size and accumulation, frozen; both are immutable on resume.
Flagship speedup over the baseline measured on this host at the same tokens per update. The proxy MFU establishes no flagship ceiling.

Measured tokens per second per allocated GPU, which re-anchors every horizon in experiments/main-data/plan.json after applying compute.throughput_reanchoring_rule.overhead_derate. This sweep runs --mode compute and excludes startup, validation and saves; the anchor it replaces includes them.
Whether the KDA custom-op work is worth funding, judged from the Hopper profile.
prerequisites: Complete the site preflight and the single-worker phases of the GH200 runbook first.
Export a persistent TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR so max-autotune compiles once, not per run.
Record SM clock, temperature and power; reject any result whose clock moved beyond 5%.
Establish a noise band from five repeats of the first configuration before reading deltas.
purpose: Confirm on GH200 the configuration selected from the RTX 3090 pass and choose the two settings that are immutable once production starts: device_batch_size and activation_checkpointing. This is a confirmation sweep, not a search.

runs.label: gh200-pilot-baseline
runs.purpose: Reproduce the frozen pilot recipe so every later delta is a flagship delta measured on production hardware. The pilot's own H100 rates are 12,859 tokens/s over the full trainer and 13,595 steady optimizer tokens/s; this run is the compute-mode counterpart and is not directly comparable to the full-trainer figure.

runs.label: gh200-noac-eager
runs.purpose: Measure the effect of removing activation recomputation at fixed geometry; the proxy gain is not a flagship prediction.

runs.label: gh200-noac-compile-mb1
runs.purpose: Measure combined model and optimizer compilation at the baseline microbatch. Record graph breaks and reasons; the proxy count is historical, not a required result.

runs.label: gh200-mb8
runs.purpose: Microbatch scaling; 96 GiB should permit this where 24 GiB could not.

runs.label: gh200-mb16
runs.purpose: Upper bound on microbatch; expected to be memory limited.

runs.label: gh200-best-nondet
runs.purpose: Price determinism at the selected microbatch. On Ampere it cost 1.086x and a larger microbatch more than repaid it. Keep determinism unless Hopper disagrees sharply.

runs.label: gh200-best-endtoend
runs.purpose: Measure packed-loader overhead against compute mode at the selected geometry. Both modes exclude startup, validation and saves; a separate sustained trainer run is required to measure the full-trainer derate.

runs.label: gh200-best-profile
runs.purpose: Evaluate the stopping rule on Hopper: useful percent, largest non-useful kernel, launch stalls and graph breaks.

out_of_scope: Compiled execution under DistributedDataParallel. This sweep is single-GPU, and base.py compiles the DDP-wrapped module with six graph breaks still present. Qualify it separately with `scripts.training_replay --compile --workers 4` before any compiled production wave.
max-autotune warmup cost, which the thirty-step measurement excludes. Amortize it per wave using the persistent TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR the Slurm renderer exports.
flagship_speedup_status: unmeasured_before_this_sweep: no flagship configuration with activation checkpointing off was ever measured, because two attempts reached 23.03 and 22.91 GiB before exhausting the 24 GiB card.
